opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £1 million

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and occasionally to improve access and research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £500,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve the display and interpretation of nationally significant collections for the public, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open and accessible to the public. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £15,000 – £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority, fully accredited under the Archive Service Accreditation Scheme, holding a permanent collection of national significance. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces for libraries and archives caring for nationally significant collections. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £15,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with significant education work. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve training and education facilities for performing arts organisations, generally towards building or refurbishing these facilities and occasionally specialist equipment. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects helping people with disabilities live more independently, particularly focusing on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards projects for charities working in mental health, with an emphasis on training, employment and supported housing. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people, particularly those with a neurodegenerative condition or who are isolated. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £50,000 – £150,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or equivalent where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants towards new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations providing excellent care to patients and their families. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £100,000; Usual grant range: £250,000 – £750,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university displaying scientific or natural history collections of national significance, fully accredited under the Museum Accreditation Scheme where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to improve public engagement with science through projects related to the history of science, generally towards refurbishing or creating new galleries and occasionally education and learning spaces. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Minimum grant amount: £25,000; Usual grant range: £40,000 – £75,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority running special schools and colleges for children and young people with special educational needs, with at least a 'Good' rating from a regulator such as CQC or Ofsted where applicable. UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants to projects supporting pupils at secondary level in special schools and colleges to develop skills to gain employment or live independently after school or college. Two-stage application process.
